title: Staff Backend Engineer, Core Infrastructure
content:
About the Company

Acme Cloud builds scalable developer infrastructure powering millions of cloud workloads globally.

What You'll Do

  • Design and maintain high-throughput distributed transaction engines in Go and TypeScript.
  • Scale database clusters across multiple availability zones with sub-50ms latency SLAs.
  • Mentor senior engineers and lead technical architecture reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of production experience in backend software engineering.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong expertise in PostgreSQL, distributed consensus, and Redis caching.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes operators and Envoy service mesh.
  • Familiarity with financial payment compliance and PCI-DSS standards.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $220,000 - $275,000 per year plus equity and benefits.
